bull.b: The reported response rates and durability provide meaningful clinical validation for iopofosine in heavily pretreated patients. If replicated in the confirmatory study, these outcomes could support differentiation, regulatory progress, and eventual commercial adoption in hematologic malignancies.

A defined confirmatory-trial and accelerated-approval roadmap gives the lead program a visible path toward commercialization. Breakthrough Designation and the anticipated FDA review timeline may help focus resources and reduce uncertainty around the next major value-creation milestone.

Very low leverage limits interest and refinancing pressure while the improved equity base provides greater financial resilience than earlier periods. This balance-sheet profile gives management more flexibility to fund clinical execution, despite the company remaining dependent on external capital.

bear.b: With no recurring product revenue and losses continuing across reporting periods, the company has not yet demonstrated commercial validation or operating leverage. Future funding and valuation support therefore remain highly dependent on clinical success, approval, and eventual product launch.

Persistent negative operating and free cash flow means the business is not self-funding and must continue using capital to sustain development. Even though burn improved from 2024, ongoing losses can reduce financial flexibility and increase dependence on future financings.

A substantial portion of planned funding depends on achieving clinical, regulatory, and market-related milestones. Any delay or failure could restrict resources for the development program, while the related warrant structure creates additional potential dilution for existing shareholders.
